description: This is a utility module written in Python for managing tasks such as time conversion, logging, file system operations, clean-up procedures, path manipulations, and platform-specific configurations, primarily used within a testing and code coverage context.

methods.name: str convert_time(seconds: float)
methods.description: Converts a duration in seconds to a formatted string HH:MM:SS.

methods.name: None print_time(message: str, start_time: float, summary_time: bool = False)
methods.description: Logs a message with the elapsed time since start_time to a log file, optionally summarizing time.

methods.name: None print_log(*args: Any)
methods.description: Logs a general message to the log file with a '[LOG]' prefix.

methods.name: None print_error(*args: Any)
methods.description: Logs an error message to the log file with an '[ERROR]' prefix.

methods.name: None remove_file(path: str)
methods.description: Deletes the file at the specified path if it exists.

methods.name: None remove_folder(path: str)
methods.description: Recursively deletes the folder at the specified path.

methods.name: None create_folder(*paths: Any)
methods.description: Creates directories at specified paths, ignoring if they already exist.

methods.name: None clean_up()
methods.description: Removes profiling folders and exits the program after cleanup.

methods.name: str convert_to_relative_path(whole_path: str, base_path: str)
methods.description: Transforms an absolute path to a relative one based on a base path.

methods.name: str replace_extension(filename: str, ext: str)
methods.description: Replaces the extension of a filename with a new extension.

methods.name: bool related_to_test_list(file_name: str, test_list: TestList)
methods.description: Checks if a filename is related to a test list based on its name.

methods.name: str get_raw_profiles_folder()
methods.description: Retrieves the environment variable for raw profiles folder or defaults to PROFILE_DIR/raw.

methods.name: CompilerType detect_compiler_type(platform: TestPlatform)
methods.description: Detects the compiler type based on the platform, importing platform-specific utils.

methods.name: str get_test_name_from_whole_path(path: str)
methods.description: Extracts the test name from a full file path.

methods.name: None check_compiler_type(cov_type: CompilerType | None)
methods.description: Verifies that the compiler type is GCC or CLANG.

methods.name: None check_platform_type(platform_type: TestPlatform)
methods.description: Verifies that the platform type is OSS or FBCODE.

methods.name: None check_test_type(test_type: str, target: str)
methods.description: Checks whether the test type is CPP or PY.

methods.name: NoReturn raise_no_test_found_exception( cpp_binary_folder: str, python_binary_folder: str )
methods.description: Raises an exception when no tests are found in specified folders.

ctags.name: print_time
ctags.pattern: /^def print_time(message: str, start_time: float, summary_time: bool = False) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (message: str, start_time: float, summary_time: bool = False)
